result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant names and cut-off category chips, partially clipped promo and restaurant cards, and incomplete bottom content that make the layout look broken.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card shows a truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off at the edge, and the card itself is partially off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards have enough padding/margin and that titles wrap or ellipsize cleanly without clipping mid-word; show partial next card intentionally with consistent spacing.

issues.description: Category filter chips on the right (after 'Healthy') are cut off mid-pill, suggesting overflow without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal scrolling with peek of the next chip and consistent end padding so chips are not abruptly clipped.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with '-20%') is heavily cropped—only the top portion is visible—making the section look incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing/scroll so full cards (or a clear partial peek) are visible above the tab bar, and ensure content isn't hidden under the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Restaurant title truncation loses meaningful words (e.g. 'Piccol' instead of full name), harming scannability.
issues.suggestion: Use multi-line titles or ellipsis after full words, and verify long names in the design.

issues.description: Promo banner and large cards use heavy crop/overlap with decorative circles; combined with edge clipping it can feel unfinished on this viewport.
issues.suggestion: Tighten banner internal padding and test safe areas so CTAs and key imagery stay fully inside rounded containers.
